file.note: The inventory is `pytest --collect-only -q` on the source at 65f36c5, in collection order. Re-run 2026-08-29 against the read-only clone of interlock at 65f36c5 with `claude` removed from PATH (the same premise this ledger's own conditionally_collected declarations below document): `PYTHONPATH=src PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/gate_item11/test_substitution_scenarios.py -p no:cacheprovider -v`: 12 collected, 6 passed ([S3]), 6 skipped ([S2] -- the `entry` fixture's own `pytest.skip(reason)`, since `shutil.which("claude")` is `None` on the porting host used for this measurement).

target_only_tests.why: None. Every collected test in this file is a translation of a source case.

approved_non_running.reason: The source's `entry` fixture calls `pytest.skip(reason)` when `registry.PROVIDERS[id].unavailable()` is not None -- one skip per case, at RUN time, so pytest still COLLECTS a node id for it. `forEachProvider`'s `skipIf(entry.unavailable() !== null, reason)` is the same condition, evaluated once per case at file load (module scope, since the six [S2] cases are declared with `test.skip`/`test` chosen at that point rather than inside the test body) -- six calls, one per [S2] case in this file. Each is genuinely reachable and independently meaningful (a different assertion body follows), so each counts on its own rather than being one approval for the file.
